facts.note: IL-700-T p.3 table-method example: 300 weekly, 2 Line-1 + 1 Line-2 allowances: weekly table 300-302 row, 2 allowances = 9.33, minus 0.95 per Line-2 allowance = 8.38. The table values are computed at the bracket midpoint (301): (301 - 2 x 2,925/52) x 4.95% = 9.33. The automated payroll method on exactly 300 gives 8.33 (il.oracle.il700t.example1.automated_method_result). Both are correct for their method; the 0.05 residual is the table midpoint, not a booklet defect.
